documents.title: Freight founder sued by investors
documents.content: Former investors filed a lawsuit against Tomas Okafor, founder of Okafor Freight, in state court. The plaintiffs claim they were misled about the company's fleet valuation. Okafor Freight declined to comment on the litigation.
